text_block_list.text: Defying the destiny dictated by "Parcae," Air Shakur made it through those three years.

Having etched her presence so strongly
that it was called the "Air Shakur Era"—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Mmm~...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this way?
...
—Today, as always, I found myself deep in thought.

“Still, some things have changed.
And that is....”

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: —Oh, your time is improving! This 'Moirai' really is something...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's rework the training a bit.
Inputting today's data into "Moirai"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: A lot more people are using "Moirai" now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Keep your voice down.
Someone's gonna hear you.

—After the Arima Kinen concluded...
Air Shakur suddenly published a portion of
"Parcae" on the web for free.

It turned into a massive uproar
that sent shockwaves through the public.
"A flawless program suddenly appeared—one that could guide everything from optimal training for that Umamusume to race simulations."
And anonymously, at that... The academy has been desperately searching for the creator of this program, which will contribute immensely to the Umamusume world, but—

We still haven't been able to identify them. However,
those with sharp intuition seem to have noticed...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up. It ain't me.
It's annoyin' day in and day out."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Sorry,
but I'm actually here on different business today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I do believe you are the creator of that program. However...
today, I would like to hear what *he* feels about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Feelings?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why did he make that public...?
I can't believe it was purely out of goodwill.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You just wanted to harvest
the data for free, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is what I thought at first as well.
However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, the students are growing immensely
thanks to 'Moirai.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, what "Moirai" provides is nothing more than thorough support.
It constantly demands thought and judgment from the user.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If all you wanted was data, there was no need to build it like this, was there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The creator of Moirai might perhaps... hold some grand philosophy.
...What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Like hell I'd know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But...—

Air Shakur shut her mouth after that
and didn't say another word.
choice_data_list: What were you really trying to say back then?
What were you really trying to say back then?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, try and guess
what I was gonna say.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Givin' up already? That was fast.
choice_data_list: Still, I can tell it's something fun.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well, guess that barely counts as correct?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Feelings, ideals, I don't give a damn about that crap.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If it's all fake, there's no reason to get hyped.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The higher the caliber of those coming after this,
the more meaning there is for me to stay here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“—Being the strongest in any era
gets you pretty hyped up, doesn't it?”
choice_data_list: Air Shakur's pretty combative, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, anyone can see that's true.
Don't go state the obvious now.

No one can ever know everything about another person.
That's true for everyone. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Enough with the idle talk.
The next race is coming up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let's get trainin'.
"I'll continue watching over her from now on. After all, time is the one thing we have plenty of――"
